title: HORAE: an annotated dataset of books of hours
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset composed entirely of 'books of hours,' which are described as 'handwritten prayer books'. The stated purpose of this dataset is to enable 'historical research on the evolution of the religious mindset in Europe' and to 'understand the devotion and religious mindsets in medieval Europe'. This directly involves creating tools for the analysis and study of religious texts and artifacts.
